| Pages Router | App Router | Key changes |
|---|---|---|
| `_app.js` + `_document.js` | `app/layout.tsx` | Root layout with `Metadata` export, `AppProvider`, header/nav/footer |
| `pages/index.js` (SSR) | `app/page.tsx` (dynamic) | `getServerSideProps` → `headers()` + `fetch`; `<Head>` → `Metadata` export; `<a>` → `<Link>` |
| `pages/blog/index.js` (ISR) | `app/blog/page.tsx` (ISR) | `getStaticProps` + `revalidate` → `fetch` with `next: { revalidate: 60 }` |
| `pages/blog/[id].js` (SSG) | `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx` | `getStaticPaths` → `generateStaticParams`; `getStaticProps` → async component; `router.isFallback` → `loading.tsx`; `notFound: true` → `notFound()` |
| `pages/404.js` | `app/not-found.tsx` | `useRouter` + `router.push` → `<Link>` |
| `pages/_error.js` | `app/error.tsx` | `getInitialProps` removed; `'use client'` boundary |
| `pages/api/posts/index.js` | `app/api/posts/route.ts` | `(req, res)` handlers → `export GET/POST` with `NextRequest`/`NextResponse` |
| `pages/api/posts/[id].js` | `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` | Same pattern, `req.query` → `context.params` |
| `components/AppProvider.js` | `components/AppProvider.tsx` | Added `'use client'`, full TypeScript types |
| — | `components/BackButton.tsx` | New client component for `router.back()` |

All files are fully typed TypeScript (`.tsx`/`.ts`). The `pages/` directory has been removed.
